title: Inebriated Fellows Performance
description: The performance modpack for my discord's minecraft server: "Inebriated Fellows"
body:
### Performance modpack for my discord server: "Inebriated Fellows"
_This is for PC's that are below normal capacity_

Enhances the vanilla experience of the game and adds a few features to the game that encourage the wonder of exploration.

Contains:

- Client-Based QoL/Optimization (Borderless Mining, Lithium/Sodium/Indium, etc.)
- Adventure Improvements (Ender Dragon Fight Remastered, Waystones, etc.)
- Chat improvements (Emojiful, Chat Heads, etc.)
- Content Packs (Deeper and Darker, Better Nether/End, etc.)
